top.h1: Visiting cards by evening. Flex by tomorrow.
top.lede: An offset press, two digital machines and a flex printer under one roof on A.P.C. Road. Visiting cards, bill books, flex banners, wedding cards, stickers, letterheads and pamphlets for shops, schools, clubs and clinics across Kolkata since 1987.

items.span: Per sq ft for star flex, frame extra

products.h2: Eight jobs we do every day of the week.
products.p: Bring a file, a sample, or a rough sketch on paper. Our designer sets it up for ₹100 to ₹300 depending on the job, and you approve a proof on WhatsApp before anything is printed.

photo.alt: A stack of blank white visiting cards on a two-tone background

products.p2: 300 gsm matte or glossy, single or both sides. Spot UV, rounded corners and textured card on request.
products.p3: Duplicate or triplicate with carbonless paper, numbered, perforated and bound. Your GST number and logo on every leaf.

photo2.alt: Colourful posters being printed on a wide-format machine

products.p4: Star flex, backlit flex and vinyl, any size up to 10 feet wide. With or without wooden frame, with eyelets for tying.

photo3.alt: A Bengali wedding card with gold border laid on a red Benarasi saree with bangles

products.p5: Bengali, English or both. Over 200 designs in the shop, or we print yours. Annaprashan, upanayan and birthday cards too.

photo4.alt: Sheets of colourful printed stickers on a white table

products.p6: Vinyl, paper and transparent. Die-cut to any shape. Product labels, jar labels, shop-front lettering, QR code stickers.
products.p7: 100 gsm bond or executive bond paper, offset printed so the colour never smudges. Matching envelopes in three sizes.

photo5.alt: Curved sheets of blue, magenta and yellow paper

products.p8: A5 and A4 on 130 gsm art paper, single or both sides. For shop openings, tuition centres, pujo committees and elections.

photo6.alt: A stack of colour swatch guides on a desk

products.p9: Folded brochures, laminated restaurant menus, school prospectuses and product catalogues. Colour matched to your logo.

rates.h2: The more you print, the less each one costs.
rates.p: Open a product to see the rate card. Prices include GST and are for print-ready files. Design, if we do it, is ₹100 to ₹300 extra. Rates updated January 2026.
rates.rn: Same-day for up to 1,000 cards if the file reaches us by 11 am. Spot UV and textured card take two working days.
rates.span2: Bill books, duplicate, 50 sets per book
rates.rn2: Serial numbering, perforation and a hard cover are included. Ready in two working days. Repeat orders are kept on file; just send the starting number.
rates.rn3: Flex up to 6 ft by 10 ft is printed in a day. Eyelets every two feet are free. Fitting at your shop in central and north Kolkata ₹300 to ₹600.
rates.rn4: Bengali typesetting is done in the shop. Proof on WhatsApp within a day; printing takes five to seven working days after you approve.
rates.rn5: Pamphlets, letterheads and stickers are same-day jobs up to 2,000 pieces when the file arrives by 11 am.

sameday.h2: Send by 11, collect by 7. Here is how the day goes.
sameday.p: For visiting cards, pamphlets, letterheads, stickers and flex up to 6 by 10 feet. Bill books, wedding cards and anything with spot UV or foil need two days or more, and we say so when you send the file.

items.p: On WhatsApp, email or a pen drive at the counter. We check size, bleed and resolution within the hour.
A photo or PDF proof on WhatsApp. You reply "ok" or ask for a change. Nothing prints before your ok.
Digital jobs go straight to the machine. Flex prints on the wide-format printer. Offset runs are planned for the next morning.
Lamination, cutting, eyelets, framing. Every job is counted and checked before it is packed.
We message you when it is packed. Collect at the counter or ask for delivery the same evening within 5 km.

files.h2: What a print-ready file looks like.
files.p: You do not need to know any of this if you want us to design the job. If you have your own designer, give them this list and the job will print right the first time.
files.h3: Not sure about any of this? Send what you have.
files.p2: Most customers send a photo of an old card or a sketch on paper. Our designer sets it up properly, sends a proof, and you approve on WhatsApp.

items.b: PDF first, then CDR, AI or high-resolution JPG
items.span: A PDF with fonts embedded is the safest. CorelDRAW files up to version 2024 and Illustrator files are fine. Word and PowerPoint files are not; we will redo them and charge for design.

items.b: 300 dpi at the actual print size
items.span: A visiting card file should be 3.5 by 2 inches at 300 dpi. A WhatsApp-forwarded image is usually 72 dpi and will print blurry. For flex, 72 to 100 dpi at full size is enough.
If your design has colour to the edge, extend it 3 mm beyond the cut line. Keep text and logos at least 3 mm inside the cut line.
Screens show RGB, presses print CMYK. Bright blues and greens shift the most. If an exact colour matters, come and see a printed swatch.

items.b: Fonts converted to curves, or embedded
items.span: Especially for Bengali text. If the font is missing on our machine the letters change. Convert to outlines or send the font file.

items.b: Tell us quantity, paper and finish in the message
items.span: One line is enough: "500 visiting cards, both sides, matte". We quote within the hour on working days.

items.li: Pamphlet, letterhead or bill book design ₹200

delivery.h2: Collect at the counter, or we bring it to the shop.

items.p: Opposite Sealdah station's south gate, two minutes from the bus stand. Jobs are packed and labelled with your name. Pay on collection, cash or UPI.
Our own delivery boy covers central and north Kolkata the same evening and the rest of the city the next morning. Flex with frames goes by tempo.
Cards, pamphlets and stickers go by courier to anywhere in West Bengal and beyond. Packed flat in board boxes. Tracking number sent on WhatsApp.

items.p: I run a medicine shop in Maniktala. Bill books every three months, same design since 2011. I send one WhatsApp with the starting number and they are at my counter in two days.
Our pujo committee needed a 20 by 10 flex at six in the evening for the next morning. They printed it that night and fitted the frame at the pandal by 9 am. Nobody else would take the job.
